svg.text: Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically — Claude checks each tool call
for risky actions and prompt injection before executing. Actions Claude identifies as safe are
executed, while actions Claude identifies as risky are blocked and Claude may try a different
approach. Ideal for long-running tasks. Claude can make mistakes that allow harmful commands
to run, it's recommended to only use in isolated environments. Shift+Tab to change mode.
Launch FOUR background subagents with model haiku in ONE message, descriptions "cart", "auth",
"router" and "docs". Each one: report a 4-stage plan via bus_step, then 4 times: read one file of
this project, run Bash sleep 6, and report each stage with bus_step. Say launched and stop.
(shift+tab to cycle) · ← for agents · ↓ to manage
